finding.description: syna_cdev_remove and syna_cdev_clear_global_data both call syna_input_agent_deregister_misc. The old helper tested misc->this_device, called misc_deregister, and left the pointer unchanged, so the second call passed the guard.
finding.target_api_behavior: Android Common 6.12 misc_deregister checks list_empty(&misc->list), emits WARN_ON and returns for an already unregistered miscdevice; it does not clear misc->this_device. The repeated call therefore generates a kernel warning and leaves a stale device pointer in the embedded structure.

details: Serialize deregistration through a dedicated static mutex.
Treat NULL and ERR_PTR this_device values as not registered.
After the first misc_deregister call, clear misc->this_device with WRITE_ONCE so later teardown paths are no-ops.

validation_limits: Canonical compile and offline API-source review only.
No Android kernel runtime, unbind/rebind exercise, or NX809J hardware validation was run.
